details.brief_summary: The main purpose of this study is to know on one hand if lorazepam is more (effective) than clonazepam and on the other hand if lorazepam is also effective as the association clonazepam + fosphenytoin in out-of-hospital treatment of the generalized convulsive status epilepticus in adult patients.
details.title: Comparison Between Lorazepam, Clonazepam and Clonazepam + Fosphenytoin for the Treatment of Out-of-hospital Generalized Status Epilepticus
